text:
emily: Kicking off onboarding for Guardian-Open (13B). Partner sent artifacts and wants three listing options: hosted, partner-remote (we proxy), and downloadable for select customers. Need legal + export + ops checklist.
rashid: quick clarifying q: downloadable = unrestricted transfer, or gated (signed MSA + attestation)?
partner-guardian: we prefer gated downloads (MSA + customer attestation). Open-source parts remain Apache2, core weights under commercial addendum. We can provide signed manifest + SLSA provenance.
zoya: ops note 6: downloadable SKUs will need a KMS provisioning flow and a gated entitlement check. Remote-proxy needs signed container and health endpoint.
legal-bot: Marketplace policy requires explicit redistribution flag: "no-download", "download-restricted", or "download-sublicensable". For gated downloads we need the customer attestation template + partner warranty. Also: export classification for NL origin required.
emily: partner says they can accept "download-restricted" where customers sign MSA and we verify attestation. They asked about allowed quantizations and whether we should list INT8 variants.
partner-guardian: supported quantizations: FP16, INT8-qt, INT4-exp. We'll include a quantization compatibility matrix. Downloads will include FP16 and INT8-qt only.
rashid: ops needs the inference profile to estimate cost banding for hosted tile and to render per-token estimate for the partner-hosted proxy.
partner-guardian: here's a lightweight profile: seq_len=2048; p50=60ms@8gpu; p95=140ms; throughput=110rps@8gpu; quantizations=[fp16,int8-qt].
ops-bot: Noted. For remote-proxy we require these fields in the tile: container_digest, health_url, billing_endpoint, telemetry_mode. Telemetry default = aggregated_only; partner can opt into more via contract.
zoya: security ask: signed manifest must include PGP sig and container signature (cosign). We also need SLSA provenance or build trace. Air-gap downloads require offline verification instructions.
legal-bot: On indemnity: partner proposes capped indemnity to insurer limits plus takedown process. Our legal prefers broader indemnity for downloadable redistribution, but we can accept cap+insurance if partner provides E&O and cyber coverage with minimum thresholds. We'll open PL ticket for review.
emily: embargo and comms: partner requests a two-week embargo after contract signoff and wants a coordinated blog + asset approval flow. Marketing will need partner logo, short quote, and approved author list.
partner-guardian: can do two-week embargo. We'll approve blog text within 48h of draft.
rashid: operational SKU matrix proposal:
- hosted: Guardian-Open (redwood-hosted)
- remote-proxy: Guardian-Open-proxy (partner endpoint, cosign container)
- downloadable: Guardian-Open-gated (MSA + attestation required)
zoya: add metadata keys: "download_allowed": "download-restricted", "attestation_template_url": "https://partner/attest.pdf", "kms_required": "true|fips_optional", "geo_block": ["CN","RU"], "telemetry": "aggregated_only". We'll gate downloadable SKU in staging until legal clears.
legal-bot: Opening PL-2007 (indemnity review) and EX-2008 (export classification) assigned to export-control. Target responses by Fri 17:00 UTC.
ops-bot: I'll create the staging tile and enable canary routing for the remote-proxy path. Downloadable SKU will be created but set to status=blocked until legal flag flips.
emily: action items summary:
- @legal-bot: indemnity + export classification by Fri EOD
- @ops-bot: staging tile + canary for remote-proxy; gate downloadable SKU
- @partner-guardian: upload insurer binder, cosign signatures, and attestation template
- @rashid: finalize pricing bands using provided inference profile
- @zoya: prepare air-gap verification docs and SRI checks
partner-guardian: we'll upload insurer binder and SLSA attestation by Thu EOD and confirm attestation template.
emily: timeline were aiming for: contract signoff Tue next week -> staging pass mid-week -> publish + co-announce two weeks after partner signoff (per embargo). If legal or export control delays, we'll default to hosted + remote-proxy and revisit downloadable later.
rashid: adding profiling artifacts to staging now 6 link: https://redwood.staging/tiles/guardian-open
ops-bot: created staging tile and canary route, tagging @emily. Downloadable SKU set to blocked.
legal-bot: filed PL-2007 and EX-2008. Will update thread with ticket links.
emily: thanks everyone. If blockers pop up, call them out here and well escalate. :sparkles:
